summary: Implement one accepted repeatable-work candidate as the smallest durable artifact without reopening its scope.

scenarios.title: Implement an accepted candidate
scenarios.prompt: Use $productize-repeatable-work to implement accepted candidate R1 exactly as recorded in this conversation.
scenarios.outcome: One narrow instruction, script, skill, hook, automation, or plugin change with relevant validation and no rediscovery.

scenarios.title: Reject a broader carrier
scenarios.prompt: Use $productize-repeatable-work for R2, but stop if the accepted target no longer fits the current repository state.
scenarios.outcome: Either a verified minimal artifact or a revised proposal explaining why the recorded target would now broaden scope.
